editor.conflictBody: The prayer times changed since you opened the editor. You can load the new copy and put your changes back on top of it (they stay unsaved so you can check them before saving), or drop them.

issue.unsafe: Contains characters that are not allowed
issue.size: Too large to save, shorten some notes and names

editor.leaveBody: If you leave now, the changes to the prayer times are lost.

card.title: Prayer times
card.body: Edit the times, the formulas and the weekly sheet. Members only see what is saved.

editor.previewEmpty: No rows with a time to show yet.
editor.previewNote: The row being edited is outlined on the sheet. Members only see what is saved.
editor.tooLong: The sheet is longer than one page. You can hide rows for this week.
editor.conflictMerged: The new copy is loaded and your changes were put back on top. Check them before saving.

card.title: Seat map
card.body: Paste the hall from your spreadsheet, check how it was read, and match every name to a household.

phone.banner: Editing is on the web only.
phone.title: Please open on a computer
phone.body: The seat map is pasted and edited on a computer. On a phone you can only read.

start.title: The synagogue seat map
start.lead: Paste the table you already have. Nothing is saved or linked until you confirm.

step.one: Open the sheet (Google Sheets or Excel) on the map tab.
step.two: Select the whole tab: Ctrl+A (⌘+A on a Mac), then copy: Ctrl+C.
step.three: Come back here and paste: Ctrl+V.

start.mapTab: Paste the map tab, not the Form responses tab.
start.targetHelp: Titles, row numbers and empty cells do not matter. We find the seats.
start.grammar: A cell reads as: "Family-1" or "Family S.-2" = a seat of that family · "פנוי" = a seat with no family · "בימה" = the bimah · empty = aisle or wall.
start.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved and no family is linked until you confirm.
start.fallback: Or paste text into the box (no merged cells)
start.privacy: Family names on the map are visible to gabbaim only. A member sees only his own block, two rows each way, with no names.

problem.too-large: The paste is too large: up to 40 rows and 60 columns. This is probably not the map.
problem.no-seats: No seats found. {rows} rows and {cols} columns were pasted, and none has a cell like "Family-1" or "פנוי".
problem.responses-tab: This looks like the Form responses tab, not the map. Responses are uploaded separately, as a responses file.
problem.hint: Make sure the whole map tab was copied, not just part of the table.

warn.two-names: Two names in one cell: "{raw}". You choose whose seat it is in the next step.
warn.duplicate-order: "{family}": the same number twice. A duplicated cell?
warn.order-gap: "{family}": a number is missing in the order. A missing seat?
warn.bimah-unsized: The bimah came as one cell and its size is unknown. It can be enlarged in structure mode.
warn.bimah-multiple: Several separate bimah areas were found.

check.lead: This is how the paste was read. This is how the hall will look.
check.hover: Hover or Tab onto a seat to see its original cell:
check.arkNote: The ark is not in the sheet. We put it at the front, above the first row, in the middle. It can be moved later.
check.spans: {n} households sit in more than one block (fine).
check.blockHelp: Right to left, as you stand facing the ark.

blockIssue.too-many: More than {max} blocks. The empty columns are probably part of the map: check the paste.

match.lead: Every name in the sheet must belong to a household of the Kehila: a family registered in the app, or a holder without an account that you create here. Nothing is linked without your confirmation.
match.bulk: {n} names match exactly one registered family (surname and first initial). Go through the list and confirm them together.
match.ambiguous: Several families fit equally: choose one.
match.optNew: New seat holder without an account
match.noneFound: No family in the app has this name.
match.sibling: There is also "{name}". If it is the same family, choose the same family for both.
match.twoNamesHelp: A seat belongs to one family.
match.litHelp: This name's seats are marked. Use it to check it is the right family.
match.pickRow: Pick a row to see its seats on the map.

save.title: Save the map
save.newHolders: {n} new holders without an account will be created.
save.noNewHolders: No new holders will be created.
save.fromHelp: Default: the first Shabbat not yet open for release. Past Shabbatot do not change.
save.replaces: A map taking effect on this Shabbat is already saved. Saving replaces it.
save.notReady: Decide every two-names cell before saving.
save.conflictTitle: Someone saved after you opened the editor
save.conflictLayout: A newer version of the map was saved. Saving now overwrites it.
save.conflictAssign: The assignments changed after you opened the editor. Saving now overwrites them.
save.overwriteSure: Sure? What is saved now will be replaced by the map you pasted.
save.done: The map is saved: {seats} seats, {holders} new holders.
save.doneHelp: Nothing is linked to an account without your confirmation.
save.replacesEarlier: The map in effect from this Shabbat has {assigned} of {seats} seats assigned. Saving rewrites the whole map and every assignment; an assignment not in the paste is erased.
save.openTitle: This Shabbat is already open for answers
save.openBody: You can save, but members who already answered will see on their seat page: "Your seats were updated by the gabbaim". Their counts move to the new seats in order.
save.partialBody: Some writes are already done. Retry (what was created is reused), or discard this partial state. Until then the date and Back are locked.

start.scratchHelp: The Kehila has no map yet. Start from an empty grid and draw the hall.

panel.pick: Pick a family from the list, or click one of its seats on the map.

picker.title: Assign the seats
picker.newHolder: New seat holder without an account
picker.name: Name (e.g. the Example family)
picker.badPhone: That phone number is not valid.

others.title: {name}'s seat
others.body: This seat belongs to another household. No seat changes hands without your choice.
others.bodyMany: {n} of the selected seats belong to other households: {names}. No seat changes hands without your choice.

move.taken: A seat of another household cannot be picked.

layout.hint: Select cells on the map, then a cell type. Keys: S seat, A aisle, B bimah, K ark, Delete empty.
layout.last: At least one row and one column must stay.
layout.pickCell: Pick a cell to remove its row or column.
layout.warn: {n} of the selected cells are taken. {names} will lose a seat. Continue?

save.title: Save the map
save.fromHelp: Past Shabbatot stay as they were.
save.replaces: A map already takes effect on this Shabbat, and it is not the one you opened. Saving replaces it.
save.openTitle: This Shabbat is already open for answers
save.openBody: You can save, but families that already answered will see that their seats were updated. Their counts move to the new seats in order.
save.newHolders: {n} new seat holders without an account will be created.
save.blockName: A block name is empty or too long.
save.rowLabel: A row name is too long (up to 8 characters).

conflict.title: A newer version exists
conflict.body: Another gabbai saved the map at {time}, after you opened it.
conflict.bodyNoTime: Another gabbai saved the map after you opened it.
conflict.apply: Apply my changes to the new version
conflict.sure: Are you sure? The newer version will be replaced by what is in the editor now.
conflict.applied: Your changes were applied to the newer version. They are not saved yet.
conflict.appliedOverlap: Your changes were applied to the newer version and are not saved yet. {n} overlapping places stayed as in the newer version.
conflict.failed: Could not read the newer version.

phone.banner: The map is edited on the website only.
phone.hint: You can see the hall and the list of families. Names appear when zoomed in.
